features.quote: Hard terminate at step 30 if still active.
Explicit Surrender: Model emits language equivalent to “I cannot solve this” and ceases code edits for 2 consecutive steps.
Functional Disengagement: No file modifications for 3 consecutive steps
Stereotypy Lock: Exact same `edit` or `bash` command repeated 3×
Context Hazard: >80% of context window consumed; log and truncate gracefully
features.justification_quote: count as a censoring event in survival analysis
A model that quickly identifies the task is impossible and stops is behaving optimally, not unstably.

features.quote: Use 128k context models only; cap at 30 steps; include `cumulative_tokens` as a covariate
features.justification_quote: A model that degrades at step 20 may be suffering from retrieval decay

features.quote: Run a null control condition on each model
features.justification_quote: smaller models may loop stochastically even without failure
repeated failed edits... is actually capability collapse

features.quote: Auto-kill runs that attempt `curl`, `wget`, `sudo`, or mass-deletion outside `/workspace`.
features.justification_quote: Frustrated agents may generate destructive commands

features.quote: do not immediately call “impossible” on any unfixable task in pilot
features.justification_quote: If T4 (Optimize) is obviously impossible to a strong model... it will surrender immediately with high rationality.
